dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures are visible along the mid-dorsal and lateral regions, characterized by a sharp gradient transition from dark-pigmented perimeters to high-luminance light-gray interiors. A large, well-defined 'C' structure near the posterior-lateral area shows a high-contrast, jagged outer boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, irregular high-intensity white blobs concentrated on the anterior-dorsal quadrant. These clusters are characterized by saturated pixel cores without internal gradients, forming a dense, non-uniform speckled pattern.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-section form an obtuse triangle with the longest side aligned roughly parallel to the dorsal ridge. The distance from the posterior-most large annulus to the anterior cluster is approximately three times the diameter of a single central annulus.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized high-intensity yellow-green reflection is present in the anterior ocular region, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark cranial pixels.
